headline: Report: Flyers’ Matvei Michkov wants ‘a new start elsewhere’
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Flyers forward Matvei Michkov wants "a new start elsewhere." Michkov, the No. 7 pick in 2023, has 14 points in 20 games to start his third NHL season.

Those 14 points flatter him a little. Michkov has 10 goals so far this season on roughly 5.5 goals worth of chances, which is the quality of his shots, so he is scoring well above what those chances suggest. At 5-on-5 PHI creates only 40% of the expected goals with him on the ice, and the team's share is 2.68 percentage points better with him off it. His 15.9 minutes a game is modest usage for a player the club has treated as a building block. That fits Charlie O'Connor of PHLY Sports, who posted that Michkov is "arguably the key piece" of the rebuild and that letting it reach this point is "an full-fledged organizational failure." Philadelphia sits at 5-10-5 and gets about 44% of the expected goals overall, so the team has little cushion to lose a young scorer. We'd also expect his trade value to look better than his underlying play, which matters to any suitor.
